_about: Outside readings of what specific provisions would do in practice: industry, environmental groups, law firms, think tanks, officials and reporters. Each take quotes its source verbatim and names the bill sections it is about; 'passage' is the bill text it argues over, located and cited by tools/build.py. A take is the source's reading, not this site's: the section summary and its cites say what the text says.
